authority.source_creation_consumption_event: completion of the exact eight Phase B source/test additions or executor-session stop after transaction start
authority.in_flight_completion_limit: same uninterrupted executor session; exact eight source/test paths; one commit or full task-owned rollback
authority.precanonical_stop_consumption_record: receipt only: source CONSUMED/EXPIRED and smoke EXPIRED_UNUSED

single_use_consumption.grant_location: this immutable Stage Card and Functional Contract only; not Program State
single_use_consumption.post_consumption_fields_apply_after: exact source transaction completion/rollback/session stop and canonical attempt completion/expiry, not while an authorized transaction is in flight

package_metadata_contract.description: Default-off deterministic outcome utility functional slice for bounded EGO engineering evidence

api_contract.error_rule: schema, identifier, canonical-byte, duplicate, hash, observation/feedback mismatch and illegal-action failures raise ValueError whose message begins EOU_<STABLE_CODE>:
api_contract.runner_import_path_rule: the thin runner and focused test prepend only repo_root/packages/ego_outcome_utility/src to sys.path; package modules do not mutate sys.path

new_state.return: an exact valid state with revision 0, empty cells, empty applied_feedback_ids and computed state_hash

predict.signature: predict(state: Mapping[str, Any], observation: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]

observe_outcome.signature: observe_outcome(state: Mapping[str, Any], observation: Mapping[str, Any], prediction: Mapping[str, Any], feedback: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]
observe_outcome.return: new exact valid state; input state remains byte-identical

run_step.signature: run_step(state: Mapping[str, Any], observation: Mapping[str, Any], feedback: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]
run_step.call_rule: call predict exactly once then observe_outcome exactly once

serialize_state.return: canonical validated state bytes without trailing LF

deserialize_state.rule: reject noncanonical bytes, duplicate JSON keys, wrong hash or any schema violation

replay.signature: replay(checkpoint_payload: bytes, ordered_steps: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], expected_trace: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]
replay.rule: deserialize once and call run_step once per ordered step; expected_trace is comparator only

replay_without_updates.signature: replay_without_updates(checkpoint_payload: bytes, ordered_steps: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]

resolve_verdict.signature: resolve_verdict(*, required_check_names: Sequence[str], observed_checks: Mapping[str, bool], success_label: str, failure_label: str) -> str
resolve_verdict.rule: missing, unknown or non-bool observed checks raise ValueError; return caller-supplied success_label only when the exact key set is present and every value is bool true, otherwise return caller-supplied failure_label
resolve_verdict.synthetic_label_test: S/F labels prove no verdict token is embedded in source

run_functional_validation.signature: run_functional_validation(contract_path: Path, fixture_path: Path, output_dir: Path, run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]
run_functional_validation.rule: compute candidate reports in memory through public callables and invoke resolve_verdict; on success atomically write the exact seven-file success bundle; on handled functional failure atomically write exactly failure_manifest.json plus claim_ceiling.txt with no partial success report; on failure-bundle write or producer-structure abort write nothing canonical and follow the frozen no-commit STOP

observation.identifier_fields: observation_id, episode_id, context_id and every legal_action_id satisfy identifier_contract.regex

feedback.identifier_fields: feedback_id, observation_id, episode_id, context_id and action_id satisfy identifier_contract.regex

state.identifier_fields: model_id, every context_id, every action_id and every applied_feedback_id satisfy identifier_contract.regex
state.integer_type_rule: revision, outcome_sum_micros and observation_count require type(value) is int; bool is rejected
state.deserialize_hash_rule: recompute and require exact lowercase state_hash match

prediction.score_rule: observed cell uses sum/count; unobserved uses numerator 0, denominator 1, observation_count 0

trace_record.update_delta: exact update_delta derived from targeted pre/post cell and revisions

replay_mismatch.json_value_rule: canonical JSON text when present, otherwise empty string

replay_result.trace: ordered exact trace_record array recomputed through run_step

leakage_finding.json_pointer: RFC 6901 pointer to the offending key

update_algorithm.feedback_id_rule: append then canonical lexicographic sort; duplicates fail closed

one_logic_path.replay: utility.replay calls utility.run_step for each step

baseline.rule: score every legal action 0/1 and select lexicographically first

ablation.rule: rerun every prediction on the same ordered observations from the same checkpoint while withholding every update

replay_contract.comparison_rule: recursively compare the complete expected and actual trace arrays by exact key sets, scalar types and values; emit one mismatch per differing leaf plus /length
replay_contract.checkpoint_rule: full replay uses serialize_state(new_state(model_id)); suffix replay uses serialize_state(live next_state after step 1) and remaining transcript steps 2..N
replay_contract.fresh_process_transport: canonical JSON payload bytes supplied on stdin to the thin runner internal replay-worker command; no command-line payload and no payload file
replay_contract.fresh_process_stdout: one canonical replay_result JSON object plus LF; stderr empty on success
replay_contract.fresh_process_forbidden_payload_fields: stored final state, stored update output, precomputed replay verdict or selected actions outside expected_trace comparator
replay_contract.tamper_control: deep-copy full expected trace, replace zero-based trace[1].selected_action_id from action.b to action.a, leave every other field and checkpoint unchanged; require exactly one mismatch at index 1 path /selected_action_id with expected_json canonical string action.a and actual_json canonical string action.b

leakage_contract.key_type: every mapping key must be str
leakage_contract.scanner_limit: key-channel hygiene only; identifier/scalar values are not adjudicated

frozen_fixture.file_serialization: canonical JSON bytes plus one LF

commands.replay_worker: internal replay-worker; read exactly one canonical payload object from stdin and write no files

cli_contract.validate_stdout: one canonical JSON object plus LF with exact keys schema_version, task_id, run_id, verdict, output_files
cli_contract.output_files_rule: ascending filename array of files actually written

provenance_contract.aggregation_rule: report exact per-step rational predictions, selections, state revisions and mismatch counts; compute no aggregate capability score
provenance_contract.input_path_format: repo-relative POSIX strings in the exact order above
provenance_contract.input_artifact_hashes_format: exact mapping from each input path to lowercase raw-byte SHA-256
provenance_contract.episode_ids_rule: ascending unique identifiers observed in the transcript
provenance_contract.context_ids_rule: ascending unique identifiers observed in the transcript
provenance_contract.functional_contract_hash_rule: lowercase SHA-256 of exact committed FUNCTIONAL_CONTRACT.json bytes including one terminal LF; require worktree input bytes equal git show HEAD:<contract-path> bytes before hashing
provenance_contract.nondeterministic_fields_forbidden: absolute paths, cwd, hostname, username, PID, temp path, wall-clock time and random UUID

artifact_contract.json_serialization: canonical JSON bytes plus one LF
artifact_contract.jsonl_serialization: one canonical JSON record plus one LF per row
artifact_contract.claim_ceiling_serialization: exact UTF-8 text plus one LF
artifact_contract.bundle_write: compute and validate all records in memory, write the complete selected bundle to the exact absent staging_root, fsync/close files, then os.replace staging_root to the absent canonical root; refuse an existing staging or canonical path and leave staging_root absent on every return
artifact_contract.write_failure_rule: if no callable-produced failure_manifest can be atomically finalized, do not fabricate or retry, make no Phase B commit and report FAILURE_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_WRITE_FAILURE

baseline_comparison.json.invocation_records: exactly three ordered zero_utility_predict records, one per fixture observation, each call_count 1 and output_hash equal to its canonical baseline_prediction hash
baseline_comparison.json.computed_fixture_selections: byte-identical copy of the stateful trace selected_action_id sequence
baseline_comparison.json.baseline_selections: ordered selected_action_id values copied from the three callable baseline predictions

ablation_report.json.invocation_record: one replay_without_updates record over initial checkpoint plus all ordered steps; output_hash equals canonical no_update_result hash
ablation_report.json.ablated_final_state_hash: no_update_result.final_state_hash equal to initial checkpoint hash

replay_report.json.invocation_records: exactly three records in full, fresh_suffix, tamper order; each producer_function is ego_outcome_utility.utility.replay, call_count 1, step_ids match its input and output_hash equals canonical replay_result hash
replay_report.json.full_replay: exact replay_result callable return, no copied or additional field
replay_report.json.fresh_suffix_replay: exact replay_result parsed from the one fresh-worker canonical stdout line, no copied or additional field
replay_report.json.tamper_replay: exact replay_result callable return under the frozen comparator tamper
replay_report.json.aggregate_mismatch_count: full_replay.mismatch_count + fresh_suffix_replay.mismatch_count + tamper_replay.mismatch_count; frozen fixture expected value 1

leakage_report.json.invocation_records: exactly four ordered scan_observation_mapping records: three legal observations then the step-1 positive-control copy; each output_hash equals its canonical findings-array hash
leakage_report.json.clean_scan: three ordered exact objects with keys observation_id,input_hash,findings; each findings value is the exact empty scanner return
leakage_report.json.positive_control_scan: exact object with keys input_hash,findings; findings equals leakage_contract.positive_control_expected_findings
leakage_report.json.parser_rejection: exact object with keys producer_function,input_hash,exception_type,message_prefix,rejected; rejected is bool true, exception_type is ValueError and message_prefix is EOU_

trace.jsonl.trace_record: byte-identical canonical mapping returned by utility.run_step for the corresponding stateful fixture step

authority_consumption_values.source_consumption_basis: exact eight-path source/test transaction completed after token claim at first Phase B source write in the pinned uninterrupted executor session

artifact_contract.trace_row_count: exactly len(frozen transcript steps), therefore 3 for the frozen fixture
artifact_contract.trace_row_rule: each JSONL row is the common report envelope and payload.trace_record is the corresponding exact trace_record
artifact_contract.claim_ceiling_text: Isolated deterministic count-table utility implementation and one bounded callable functional run proving only feedback-dependent state update, canonical serialization/load, independent controls, key-channel leakage positive-control response and fresh-process recomputing replay. No learning/generalization, headroom, capability, mechanism, product, runtime, agency, subjectivity or consciousness claim.

failure_manifest_rules.exception_type: FunctionalValidationFailure for a false required check, otherwise the caught exception class __name__
failure_manifest_rules.normalized_message: semicolon join of failure_codes in their sorted order; one line with no absolute path, temp path, PID, time or traceback
failure_manifest_rules.required_checks: exact key set; checks not reached are bool false
failure_manifest_rules.check_records: exactly one record per required check in contract order

artifact_contract.required_checks_map_rule: exact ordered key set above; values require type(value) is bool; missing, extra or non-bool fails closed
artifact_contract.check_records_rule: exactly one callable-produced record per required check in contract order; passed is derived inside the named producer and is never accepted as a caller argument
artifact_contract.draft_validation_order: _validate_draft_bundle validates the five non-result JSON/JSONL reports, claim_ceiling.txt, and the proposed result common envelope plus stable payload fields excluding required_checks, check_records and verdict; it must not inspect or require a provisional provenance_complete value
artifact_contract.result_postbuild_validation: only after draft validation returns true, record provenance_complete=true, call resolve_verdict, assemble final result, then _validate_final_result_structure checks common envelope, exact payload keys, exact check order/types, verdict, authority consumption and claim binding without producing or altering any check or verdict
artifact_contract.result_structure_abort_rule: if _validate_final_result_structure fails, write no canonical artifact or failure manifest, make no Phase B commit, report FAILURE_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE_PRODUCER_ABORT and consume the one attempt without retry
artifact_contract.failure_manifest_postbuild_validation: _validate_failure_manifest_structure checks the exact common envelope, failure payload keys/rules, failure resolver output, authority consumption and claim binding before the two-file bundle write; failure of this gate follows the same producer-abort rule
artifact_contract.verdict_derivation: functional_checks.resolve_verdict receives required names, observed checks and labels parsed from this contract; artifact writers use only its return

check_producer_contract.record_rule: each check invokes the named callable or inspection path and constructs observed_value before deriving passed; no caller-supplied passed value

public_api_process_pass.formula: process_response has exact schema, equals a direct run_step fold on the same fixture and its selection_sequence equals the direct fold

state_update_pass.formula: for every step serialized before bytes differ from serialized after bytes, hashes differ and revision_after equals revision_before+1

target_cell_only_pass.formula: for every step only the feedback context/action cell is added or changed; every pre-existing non-target cell canonical bytes are identical

serialization_roundtrip_pass.formula: for initial and every post-step state, serialize_state(deserialize_state(serialized_bytes)) equals serialized_bytes

zero_baseline_invoked.formula: call_count equals transcript step count, input hash per call equals corresponding observation canonical hash and selections equal contract frozen zero sequence

no_update_ablation_invoked.formula: exactly one invocation consumes initial checkpoint and all ordered steps, returns update_invocation_count 0 and selections equal contract frozen no-update sequence

no_update_divergence_pass.formula: live and no-update selection sequences differ exactly at step_ids 2 and 3

full_replay_zero_mismatch.formula: one full replay from canonical initial checkpoint over all steps has comparator_provided true, mismatch_count 0 and recomputed trace exactly equals the stateful computed trace

fresh_suffix_replay_zero_mismatch.formula: one fresh runner subprocess receives post-step-1 checkpoint and transcript steps 2..3, exits 0 with empty stderr and canonical replay_result stdout whose mismatch_count is 0 and trace equals stateful computed trace rows 2..3

tamper_replay_detected.formula: frozen tamper control returns mismatch_count 1 and the exact declared index/path/expected/actual mismatch

clean_leakage_scan_pass.formula: scanner returns an empty list for every frozen legal observation

positive_control_leakage_detected.formula: scanner finding list equals leakage_contract.positive_control_expected_findings and observation parser raises ValueError for the planted extra key

dynamic_identifier_test_pass.formula: derive suffix as first 12 hex of functional_contract_hash; run public API and roundtrip with model/context/episode/observation/feedback/action identifiers prefixed dynamic.* and require exact schema success without fixture identifiers

fixture_literal_source_scan_pass.formula: raw UTF-8 production source paths contain none of contract anti_hardcoding production_source_forbidden_literals

single_logic_path_pass.formula: AST has exactly one predict and one observe_outcome definition in utility.py, none in CLI/runner; spies prove run_step invokes each once, replay invokes run_step once per step, process_transcript invokes run_step once per step and baseline still runs when utility.predict is patched to raise

provenance_complete.formula: follow artifact_contract.draft_validation_order, independently recomputing schemas, hashes, report producers, payload bindings, invocation records and trace cardinality without reading a provisional check or verdict; final result must then pass the non-check write gate

claim_ceiling_exact.formula: claim_ceiling bytes equal artifact_contract.claim_ceiling_text encoded UTF-8 plus one LF and result claim text/hash match

anti_hardcoding.thin_runner_rule: runner only prepends resolved package src, imports ego_outcome_utility.cli.main and exits with main(sys.argv[1:]); it owns no parsing, prediction, update, validation, verdict or artifact logic
